name: Tiberius
description: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament

points: Is it lawful to give tribute unto Cesar, or not: is it lawful to give taxes unto Caesar? They was trying to catch him up.

Render therefore unto Cesar the things which are Cesar's; and unto God the things that are God's: so he said, look at this money. Is that our image on the money? No. What is he showing you? Captivity. Slaves.
Luke 2:1 names Caesar Augustus; Luke 3:1 names Tiberius. These are the feathers we are reading about in Esdras.

Tiberius, see the part where it says Tiberius was emperor during the crucifixion, AD 30 or 33. So, this is when the time when Christ was an adult. So, when you're reading the four Gospels, it's Tiberius who was the emperor, who was the Caesar of the time.

The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar: they said, "We have no king but Caesar." Why were the Jews saying that their king was Caesar, who was a Roman? Because they were in slavery. Just like today, ask a negro who his king is. He going to say President Trump or Joe Biden or JFK. Same thing today.
